svg.aria-label: Join the 3V3 pin to the + rail and GND to the − rail
svg.text: Join the 3V3 pin to the + rail and GND to the − rail
The XIAO straddles the center gap, USB end to the left: two free holes above each top pin, three below each bottom pin
GND pin column to the − rail
Nothing connects to 5V, D0 or D6 to D9
